summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P Spin-Off ETF (CSD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P U.S. Spin-Off index. The fund tracks an index of mostly large- and mid-cap US equities that have broken away from their parent firms in the last 4 years. CSD was launched on Dec 15, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: CSD is an equity ETF with a total of 32 individual holdings. The top holdings are GE HealthCare Technologies stock at 7.84%, Veralto at 7.77%, Honeywell Aerospace at 7.69%, GE Vernova at 7.64%, and Qnity Electronics at 7.62%.
